entries.zh: 起草文书；把公文发出（向官员呈递）
entries.en: to draw up and dispatch an official document (to the mandarin)

entries.zh: 打开；掰开、敞开（把闭合之物拍开）
entries.en: to open (something closed); to force open, throw open
entries.notes: L 词形可疑（Desparar…[疑:rinen]），义据 H「扑開」与 M peh-khí 定为「打开」。

entries.zh: 剪烛花；剪掉烧残的灯芯
entries.en: to snuff a candle; to trim the burnt wick
to take one's leave; to say goodbye
entries.notes: L 末词 Niori [疑:Nioni] 不可解，释义仅据 H「辞」与 R zû 定。

entries.en: to take leave from a distance; to part far off
entries.notes: L 词形残损（[疑:aMifarn]），四栏唯 H「遠」/M oán 可据，故取「远别」。

entries.en: to take leave of and forsake (a long-standing companion)
entries.notes: L 作 declarangu [疑]，疑为 de la larga compañía 之残；H/M/R 一致作「遠棄」。

entries.en: to take leave and return home; to bid farewell on departing

entries.zh: 拜别；弟子向师长行礼告辞
entries.en: to take leave of one's master/teacher with a bow

entries.zh: 送风；为远行者饯行、送行
entries.en: to give a send-off; to see someone off with a parting gift or feast
entries.notes: L「alguala」残缺（疑 alguna partida）；H「送風」/M sàng-hong 明指送行。

entries.en: to see a guest off; to escort a visitor out
to relinquish office; to take leave of one's post (as a judge when a case ends)
to take one's leave and withdraw; to part with a farewell

entries.zh: 向您告辞（我向阁下辞别）
entries.en: I take my leave of you (Your Mercy)

entries.notes: H、R 两栏空缺，L 词形可疑（[疑:Despedeyor]），仅存 M 音写 hun-chūy-chô，无法定夺。

entries.zh: 买办；采买，采购（替主家采办日用的人）

entries.notes: L 有 [疑:gastador]；H「打擦」字形与 M pah-tsàn 的对应不确，义依 L 主轴定。

entries.zh: 伸懒腰；舒展身体（睡醒时伸展）
entries.notes: L「Desperecarse」疑为 desperezarse；H「春」当是「伸」(tshun) 的同音借写。
M 栏多出音节且末音 T99 污损，H「攬項」[疑:榥]，四栏不能互证。
